europe_now.title: Ukraine downs jet-powered Russian drones as Moscow seeks to expand production
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian forces have demonstrated the ability to shoot down jet-powered Russian drones. Russia is reportedly seeking to increase production of such unmanned aircraft.

sources.headline: Ukraine shows how it shoots down jet-powered Russian drones, as Moscow seeks to expand production (Ukraine Battlefield update, day 1,671)

europe_now.title: EU cyber agency reports Chinese hackers attacked shipping in seven EU states
europe_now.summary: Chinese hackers targeted shipping operations in at least seven European Union countries in 2025, according to the EU cyber agency. The attacks underscore rising cyber threats to EU maritime infrastructure.

sources.headline: EU-Cyberbehörde: Chinesische Hacker haben 2025 die Schifffahrt in mindestens sieben EU-Staaten angegriffen

top_stories.title: EU-Philippines trade agreement expands Asia ties
top_stories.summary: The European Union has finalized a free-trade agreement with the Philippines. The deal adds to Brussels' expanding portfolio of Asia-focused trade partnerships.

sources.headline: EU-Philippines free-trade pact joins Brussels’ growing ‘harvest’ of Asia deals

top_stories.title: Macron urges EU action on energy prices while Italy misses fiscal exit
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has called on the European Union to address rising energy prices across member states. At the same time, Italy has failed to meet the requirements for an early exit from the EU's fiscal surveillance framework.

sources.headline: Macron calls on EU to tackle soaring energy prices
In blow to Meloni, Italy misses early exit from EU fiscal watch

top_stories.title: German minister criticizes EU budget commissioner
top_stories.summary: A German minister has accused the EU budget commissioner of being out of touch with reality. The remark reflects growing disagreements over the direction of the EU's budget.

sources.headline: German minister slams Costa over EU budget, says he has ‘completely lost touch with reality’
